title: Branch Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Medcity International Academy (MIA) is a premier training and coaching institution headquartered in Kannur, Kerala, with multiple centers across Kerala and Karnataka. It is recognized as a leading provider of English language proficiency and professional assessment test training, with a strong focus on international exam success and global employability. MIA offers specialized preparatory programs for major language tests and healthcare licensure exams, supported by experienced trainers certified by global bodies. The Academy combines evidence\-based teaching methods, digital tools, personalized coaching, and app\-based learning to support both online and classroom learners. Its mission is to expand global opportunities for students and professionals across healthcare, IT, engineering, hospitality, aviation, tourism, and communications through impactful education and strategic training.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Branch Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based at the Thrissur center, responsible for overseeing daily operations and ensuring smooth functioning of all academic and administrative activities. This role includes managing staff schedules and performance, coordinating training programs, and maintaining high service standards for learners and partners. The Branch Manager will monitor enrollment targets, drive local marketing initiatives, and build relationships with schools, colleges, and other stakeholders. They will handle budgeting and resource planning, track key performance indicators, and ensure compliance with organizational policies and quality benchmarks. The role also involves resolving escalated learner issues, implementing process improvements, and collaborating with senior management to align the branch with overall institutional goals.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience supervising teams and fostering collaborative work environments.
* Operational and administrative management abilities, including center management, scheduling, budgeting, and process optimization.
* Customer service and stakeholder relationship skills to interact effectively with learners, parents, institutional partners, and vendors.
* Sales and marketing acumen, including local outreach, lead generation, and conversion to meet enrollment and revenue targets.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in English; knowledge of local languages is an advantage.
* Ability to analyze data, track performance metrics, and use digital tools and CRM or learning management systems for decision\-making.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, education, management, or a related field; postgraduate qualifications are preferred.
* Prior experience in education, training, test prep, or service\-oriented industries in a branch or center management role is highly desirable.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work under time constraints while maintaining quality standards.

title: HR Generalist
description:
Alpha Drop Ventures is building the standard layer for cultural commerce. At the center is DROPZ, our core platform. Around it sit the brands we build and own, each one setting the bar for what credible culture\-led product looks like. We are pre\-launch and raising. The people joining now could be doing easier things elsewhere. They're choosing this instead. We need someone to own the people side of the company as it gets built.
   

  

**The Role**
 You own hiring and HR end to end. Finding the right people, running the process that filters them properly, getting them set up, and building the policies and culture systems that hold the team together as we grow. This is not a support role. You initiate, you own, and you drive.
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end recruitment across roles, from sourcing and screening to coordinating assessments, interviews, and offer communication
* Build and run a clean onboarding process so every new hire understands the standard, the systems, and the culture from day one
* Design and maintain HR policies that are legally sound, fair, and specific to how this company actually operates, not generic templates
* Build team culture and internal engagement through structured, intentional activities, not ad hoc gestures
* Handle core HR operations including documentation, compliance, and employee lifecycle processes from onboarding through separation
* Maintain accurate hiring and HR data, tracking pipeline status, headcount, and process gaps so decisions are made on real information
* Build and improve HR infrastructure as the team scales, including screening frameworks, policy documentation, and internal systems


**What This Actually Is**
 This is a founding team role. That means more than a title.
   

  

* You are not filling seats or running a checklist. You are building the people function of the company from the ground up. The decisions you make now become how this company operates for years
* You will work across hiring and HR operations simultaneously, switching context quickly without dropping quality on either side
* Feedback is direct and unfiltered. You hear clearly when something is off and when it lands, and you are expected to handle both calmly
* You will help define how Alpha Drop hires, onboards, and operates before there is a mature HR function to lean on. That is the rare part of this role and the demanding part


 If you want a narrow scope where hiring and HR are two separate people's jobs, this is the wrong room, and that is fine.
   

  

**How We Build And What Sets You Apart**
 We are here to build something, not make noise around something. We hold a high bar and we hold it together. The role gets you hired. This is what makes you matter here.
   

  

* You treat candidate quality and employee experience as your personal standard, not a metric someone else tracks
* You spot the gap in a process, a policy, or a pipeline before anyone asks about it, and you already have a plan to fix it
* You give candidates and employees a clear and honest experience throughout, because how we hire and how we treat people is part of how we are known
* You build things that outlast the task. Policies, frameworks, and systems, not just resolved tickets
* No passive feedback, no dropped context, no low effort with an excuse attached
* When a deadline is at risk, you raise it early. When a hire is not the right fit or a policy is not working, you say it clearly and fix it
* You protect the standard across every part of the people function, because one weak hire or one broken policy affects the whole team
* Going above and beyond is not about hours. It is about caring more precisely than the task requires, and building people systems like the team will be judged by them for years


**Who You Are**
* Minimum 18 months in HR, talent acquisition, or a combined people operations role, with proven ownership of both hiring and core HR activities
* Able to run end\-to\-end recruitment independently, from sourcing through offer, without needing the process handed to you
* Experienced in building or managing HR policy, documentation, and employee lifecycle processes in a real operating environment
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can represent the company well to candidates and employees alike
* Organised with pipelines, records, and processes, keeping everything visible and current without being reminded
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and decisions made on incomplete information, then refining from feedback and results
* Genuinely interested in people and culture building, not just process execution. You want to shape how a high\-standard company hires, onboards, and operates


 Build with us. Do not perform for us.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Lyka Packaging Pvt. Ltd. is a specialized provider of plastic food containers, serving diverse food packaging needs with high\-quality, durable solutions. The company is supported by a professional team of engineers who collaborate closely with customers to design and deliver effective packaging options. Management emphasizes innovation and continuous improvement, ensuring the organization stays aligned with the latest developments in packaging technology and market trends. With an in\-house moulding facility, best\-in\-class injection moulding machines, and integrated printing and in\-mould labelling (IML) capabilities, Lyka Packaging offers end\-to\-end packaging solutions under one roof.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ernakulam. This role is responsible for overseeing the entire employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include partnering with department heads to identify staffing needs, managing HR policies and compliance, and maintaining accurate HR records and documentation. The Human Resources Manager will handle employee relations, support training and development initiatives, and contribute to a positive, inclusive workplace culture. The role also involves monitoring labor law compliance, supporting payroll and benefits coordination with relevant teams, and recommending process improvements to strengthen HR operations.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Experience in HR policy development, implementation, and compliance with applicable labor laws and regulations.
* Skills in conflict resolution, coaching, and supporting employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Proficiency in HRIS or HR management software and comfortable working with spreadsheets and documentation tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and levels.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maintain professional ethics.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a similar HR leadership role, preferably in manufacturing or packaging industries.
* Comfort working on\-site in Ernakulam and engaging directly with production, engineering, and management teams.

title: Workforce Manager
description:
**Hiring for Big\-4** 




  





**Job Title: Manager\- Organization and Workforce Transformation** 




**Business Unit: People Consulting** 




  





**The Opportunity** 




  





 We help clients reimagine the future of work and transform their organizations to drive strategic growth and improved employee experience. As a Manager – Organization and Workforce Transformation within our People Consulting team, you will lead and deliver large\-scale transformation initiatives across Workforce Strategy, and Talent Management solutions.
 



 In this role, you will collaborate with senior client stakeholders to design and implement integrated solutions spanning Talent Management Framework, Total Rewards, Leadership Development, Strategic Workforce Planning, and HR analytics. You will play a key role in translating business strategy into actionable workforce and HR interventions that deliver measurable impact.
 



  





**Your Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead Organization and Workforce Transformation engagements, focusing on people strategy and Talent Management frameworks including competency management, Career Framework, succession planning etc.
* Deliver Total Rewards solutions, including job evaluation, compensation benchmarking, and benefits strategy design.
* Deliver leadership assessment and development programs, including 360\-degree assessments and targeted capability\-building initiatives.
* Lead Strategic Workforce Planning projects, including demand\-supply analysis, scenario planning, and workforce optimization strategies.
* Leverage HR analytics to generate data\-driven insights, enabling informed decision\-making and improved workforce outcomes.
* Facilitate client workshops and stakeholder sessions to drive alignment, co\-create solutions, and support transformation adoption.
* Develop thought leadership, point\-of\-view (PoV) content, and reusable tools/assets to strengthen capabilities and support client solutioning.
* Stay informed on emerging HR trends, tools, and leading practices to enhance solution design and delivery.



  





**What You’ll Need to Succeed** 




  




* Strong understanding of Organization and Workforce Transformation, including People strategy, Workforce planning and Talent Management practices.
* Expertise in Total Rewards, including Job Evaluation, Compensation Benchmarking, and benefits strategy.
* Experience in psychometric assessments, competency frameworks, and talent assessment methodologies.
* Proficiency in HR analytics, workforce planning, and data\-driven decision\-making approaches.
* Excellent project management skills, with experience managing multiple workstreams and meeting timelines.



  





**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:** 




  




* 10\+ years of experience in HR consulting, organization and workforce transformation, or related advisory roles.
* Proven experience in leading enterprise\-wide Talent Management initiatives.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in human resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Prosci, CIPD, SHRM, or psychometric assessment certifications) are an advantage.
* Experience in professional services or global consulting environments is preferred.



  





  





 Compensation Benchmarking, Workforce Planning, Succession Planning, Organizational Workforce Transformation (OWT), Strategic workforce advisory, Organization design, Consulting experience required, Client facing role

title: HR Executive
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **HR Executive** 
 to manage end\-to\-end HR operations and administration for the organization. The role will be responsible for talent acquisition, manpower planning, employee engagement, performance management, statutory compliance, employee relations and HR administration.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Planning**
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for plant and corporate positions.
* Develop manpower plans based on business and operational requirements.
* Manage onboarding, induction, employee documentation and exits.
* Partner with business heads to identify current and future manpower requirements.


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations and employee lifecycle processes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Manage PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Factory Act and other statutory compliances.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR MIS and personnel documentation.
* Coordinate statutory audits, inspections and compliance activities.


**Employee Relations \& Engagement**
* Handle employee queries, grievances and disciplinary matters.
* Maintain positive employee relations and workplace culture.
* Drive employee engagement, welfare and retention initiatives.
* Support industrial relations and shop\-floor employee matters.


**Performance Management \& Training**
* Coordinate performance appraisal and review processes.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Coordinate employee training, learning and development initiatives.
* Monitor training effectiveness and employee development.


**Payroll \& HR Administration**
* Coordinate payroll inputs, attendance, leave and employee master data.
* Work closely with Finance/payroll vendors to ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
* Manage HR policies, procedures and employee communication.
* Oversee general administration, facilities and vendor coordination as required.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree with MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* 2\+ years of experience in HR Generalist / HR Operations roles.
* Experience in manufacturing / engineering / industrial environment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management and HR operations.
* Good knowledge of PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Factory Act and POSH.
* Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder\-management skills.
